BiblicalUsage: Wailing is what there shall not be. Ezekiel says violence has risen into a rod of wickedness, and none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, and neither shall there be wailing for them — the ruin is so complete that no one is left to lament it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the absence of wailing is the worst of it: a people so consumed that no voice rises over them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
